content:
Noah (Capacity): Quick announce: Nimble N200 dedicated pools entering limited availability next week in SEA-3 and GRU-1. Short thread with windows, migration notes, and a tiny pilot incident.
DeployBot: Maintenance window scheduled: 2026-10-06 03:00-05:00 UTC for kernel preload and telemetry hooks.
Noah (Capacity): Nimble N200 is tuned for latency-sensitive multimodal workloads and batched embeddings. We saw ~1.5x embeddings throughput vs our A-series in internal benchmarks.
Ivy (Product): Pricing / reservation limits?
Noah (Capacity): Intro trial pricing: burst $1.05/hr, reserved trial $1.65/hr per GPU. Min reservation: 1 GPU for micro-pools; per-customer cap during trial: 64 GPUs. No SLA change for trial.
SE Concierge: Routing note: add label `nimble-n200-compatible` or explicit fallback to `stable-dedicated`. Preemptible fallback enabled by default; can be disabled per-reservation.
Infra Oncall: Pilot incident: in GRU-1 we observed a short BIOS restart on 2 hosts during an automated rack firmware sweep. Impact: ~4 minutes allocation churn, no customer-facing errors. Cause: vendor firmware reconciliation issue.
Infra Oncall: Mitigation: flagged affected hosts, held firmware sweep, and adjusted host drain window to 6 minutes. If you see `bios-restart` or `host-drain` logs, page infra immediately.
Noah (Capacity): Availability waves (UTC):
 - SEA-3: Mon/Wed/Fri 00:00-04:00 (wave A)
 - GRU-1: Tue/Thu/Sat 12:00-16:00 (wave B)
 - Burst floor: 3 GPUs per zone outside waves.
Ivy (Product): Any runtime flags to recommend?
Noah (Capacity): Recommend `--exec-mode low_latency`, enable `kv-cache=true`, and use `--quant-profile nimble_mix`. For embeddings, `max_batch_size=128` yields best throughput. Example reservation CLI:
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool nimble-n200-gru-1 --gpus 4 --term 168h --tags "nimble-beta,embeddings"
```
Support L2: Will customers need special handling for billing or refunds?
Noah (Capacity): Billing unchanged; trial tag `nimble-beta` enables telemetry and temporary quota bumps. Cancellation window for trial reserved blocks: 6 hours prior to start (shorter to help rebalance).
SE Concierge: We'll schedule 1:1 perf sessions with 4 key customers in AP/BR regions.
Noah (Capacity): Action items: @eng-runtime validate top 8 customer models; @support draft FAQ snippet; @sales flag prospects in LATAM/APAC. React with :white_check_mark: when you own an item. Keeping this thread for live updates during the limited availability.
